name: unitree_g1_dex3
_note: Pelvis welded at standing height (manipulation only, no balance control).

base._note: 1.3 m tall with ~0.5 m arms: stands close (the counter body is recessed under the slab; the torso's front is ~0.1 m ahead of the pelvis, so 0.08 m is about the closest the chest clears a slab edge). Lateral is where the base stands to the right (+) of the target: the reaching right shoulder sits 0.1 m right of the pelvis (arms.right.shoulder), so the base stands up to 0.25 m LEFT of the target and the target falls in front of that shoulder (-0.15 .. +0.1 m); the former [0, 0.3] put it 0.1-0.4 m across the body

bodex._note: BODex hand asset (grasping.bodex): its base link and joint names are this arm's hand link / joints

right._shoulder: first arm joint's link at home, base frame (z above the base mount): BODex seeds face it

cameras._mount: head_link's mesh spans z 0.33-0.53 m, front face x 0.074 m
